name: Drifter (CR 1)
body:
Drifter
CR 1

XP 400
Male halfling expert 3
CN Small humanoid (halfling)
Init +2; Senses Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +1 size)
hp 13 (3d8)
Fort +2, Ref +4, Will +4; +2 vs. fear

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee dagger +3 (1d3/19–20)
Ranged dragon pistol (1d4/x4) or dagger +5 (1d3/19-20)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 15, Con 10, Int 8, Wis 11, Cha 11
Base Atk +2; CMB +1; CMD 13
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot
Skills Acrobatics +4 (+0 when jumping), Climb +7, Craft (carpentry) +5, Knowledge (nature) +3, Perception +7, Profession (woodcutter) +6, Ride +6, Stealth +11, Survival +6, Swim +4; Racial Modifiers +2 Acrobatics, +2 Climb, +2 Perception
Languages Common, Halfling
Gear potion of cure light wounds; Other Gear armored jacket, 2 daggers, dragon pistol with 2 dragon’s breath cartridges, 2 entangling shot cartridges, 6 pellet shot cartridges, and 10 metal cartridges, fragmentation grenades (2), 8 gp, guard dog

A drifter wanders from place to place with his trusty pet, eking out a living on the fringes of society and trying to avoid trouble.
